snp5.18:0.2: (Verses in Praise of the Way to the Beyond)
snp5.18:1.1: This was said by the Fortunate One while living among the Magadhans at the Pāsāṇaka shrine.
snp5.18:1.2: The sixteen attendant brahmins requested, asked, and asked, and he answered the questions.
snp5.18:1.3: If, knowing the meaning of each question, knowing the Teaching, he would practice in conformity with the Teaching, he would surely go beyond old age and death.
snp5.18:1.4: It is said these teachings go to the beyond, therefore this presentation of the Teaching is indeed called The Way to the Beyond.
snp5.18:2.1: Ajita, Tissa Metteyya, Puṇṇaka, also Mettagū,
snp5.18:2.3: Dhotaka, and Upasīva, Nanda, and also Hemaka,
snp5.18:3.1: the two: Todeyya, and Kappa, and Jatukaṇṇī, the one who is wise,
snp5.18:3.3: Bhadrāvudha, and Udaya, also the brahmin Posāla,
snp5.18:3.5: Mogharāja, the intelligent one, and the great seer Piṅgiya.
snp5.18:4.2: to the seer with perfect conduct,
snp5.18:4.4: they went to the Buddha who is best.
snp5.18:5.1: The Buddha answered as it truly is the questions that they asked,
snp5.18:5.3: and by answering the questions the sage satisfied those brahmins.
snp5.18:6.1: They, being satisfied by the Visionary, the Buddha, the kinsman of the sun,
snp5.18:6.3: lived the spiritual life under the One With Excellent Wisdom.
snp5.18:7.1: The Buddha taught like this (in response) to the questions one by one,
snp5.18:7.3: he who practices like this can go from here to the beyond.
snp5.18:8.1: From here to the beyond he can go by developing the supreme path.
snp5.18:8.3: This is the path for going to the beyond,
snp5.18:8.4: therefore it is called The Way to the Beyond.
